item.title: Rallying Cry – October 20, 2026
item.description: From a dyslexic artist finding her voice through creativity to breakthroughs in predicting stroke risk with AI, plus a new railway station set to boost travel in the north and Amazon funding clean energy, today’s news is full of inspiring progress.
